$note: 財帛宮（2026-10-12）：天機.財帛。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 財帛宮 p.436–462。倒閉、破產、官非、盜賊、火災、疾病一類斷語不用；金額、「巨富」一類保證不用；天刑、天月、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用。

rules.text: 天機化權，財帛較穩定，但仍要轉換財源；以自由職業或專業較合適。
rules.en: Tian Ji in Authority: money is steadier, but the sources still change; freelance or professional work suits you best.

rules.text: 天機化祿，財源不只一端；見吉星，有多方面的財路。
rules.en: Tian Ji in Abundance: income comes from more than one place, and with helpful stars, from many.

rules.text: 天機化忌，財運稍順就容易受打擊或排擠；逆境時處之泰然，才守得住。
rules.en: Tian Ji in Hindrance: as soon as money starts flowing, setbacks or pushback follow; stay calm through the hard spells to keep what you have.

source.quote: 必须于逆境时处之泰然
